description: Annual Christmas mapping event. This pack features 25 "small" maps in varying styles where all gameplay takes place within a 1024x1024x1024 space. It runs on Arcane Dimensions 1.8 (included) and comes with some additional content like sounds, models, skyboxes and music tracks. The map sources are included.
notes: These maps require a source port with increased limits + BSP2 support.

description: Around medium-sized level using developer textures; a test map for AD's Chaos mode. The map source and the texture wad are included.
notes: This map requires Arcane Dimensions 1.81.

description: Large-scale single player campaign with many new levels, some of them labeled as "test" maps, featuring a whole line-up of new monsters and items as well as several tweaks and changes to the gameplay. Furthermore, it is meant to serve as a tool box for level designers, offering a large number of modified and new things to use in custom-made maps. Map and QC sources are included.
notes: This is version 1.8 (including patch 1) which includes various bug-fixes, additional features, and four additional maps: Grendel's Blade and Nyarlathoteps Sand Castle as well as Ak-Alakha by PulSaR and Tears of the False God by Bal (pictured).
These maps (and all subsequent maps based on AD) require a source port with increased limits as well as support for BSP2 and transparent textures. Quakespasm 0.93+ is strongly recommended.

description: Results of an impromptu speedmapping/jam session following a "lifts and zombies and 20ish monsters" theme. The map sources are included.
Results of an impromptu speedmapping/jam session following a "medieval E1M2 style brickwork and about 20 monsters" theme. The map sources are included.
Large runic fortress built around a huge sword thrust into the ground. The map source is included.
notes: This map requires Arcane Dimensions 1.71 and a source port with increased limits.

description: Small level created in the spirit of the 100b competitions (using not more than 100 world brushes). The map source is included.
notes: This map requires Arcane Dimensions.

description: Arcane Dimensions version 1.71 patch featuring various bug-fixes and an additional level: a remake/remix of Ademantine Cruelty.
notes: This patch requires Arcane Dimensions 1.70 to be installed.

description: Large Egyptian-themed temple. The map source is included.
notes: This map requires Arcane Dimensions and an engine port with increased limits.

description: Large-scale single player campaign with many new levels, some of them labeled as "test" maps, featuring a whole line-up of new monsters and items as well as several tweaks and changes to the gameplay. It is also meant to serve as a tool box for level designers. Map and QC sources are included.
notes: A patch for 1.5 is available here
These maps require an engine port with increased limits as well as support for BSP2 and transparent textures. They are mainly designed to be played with QuakeSpasm 0.92.0 or later.

description: Two small maps made over two days. Gameplay is experimental and focuses solely on exploration and finding the way to progress. There are no monsters and no serious threats to the player.
notes: The map sources are included. These maps require an engine with skybox support.

description: Large-scale single player campaign with many new levels, some of them labeled as "test" maps, featuring a whole line-up of new monsters and items as well as several tweaks and changes to the gameplay. It is also meant to serve as a tool box for level designers. Map and QC sources are included.
notes: These maps require an engine port with increased limits, support for BSP2 and transparent textures. They are designed to be played with QuakeSpasm 0.91.0 or later.
A patch is available here.

description: Speedy map jam following the theme "Fantasy brick cities in the skies": three floating maps by Skacky, Sock and RickyT23. It comes with optional medieval-style item models.
tags: title=Retro Jam 2 - Fantasy Brick Cities in the Skies Theme

description: Small medieval map, set in a courtyard and surrounding buildings. An expanded version of Sock's map from Retro Jam 1, featuring bug fixes, a skill selection section, additional areas and gameplay, and more secrets than the original version of the map.

Impromptu map jam following a "retro" medieval/castle theme: five small maps by ericw, mfx, Scampie, Skacky and sock. It comes with optional medieval-style item models, and the map sources are included.
notes: A rebalanced version of mfx's map is available here, and a fixed version of Skacky's map is available here. An expanded and polished standalone version of Sock's map is available here.

description: Expanded standalone version of sock's map from Func Map Jam 2: a medium-sized, IKblue-themed, partially ruined temple with two individual routes for replayablility. It comes with a set of medieval-style item boxes.

Map jam #2 - a community project at Func_Msgboard. The pack features 8 medium to large ikblue / ikwhite-themed maps. It comes with a couple of modified models and custom skyboxes. The map sources are included. Some of the maps require an engine port with increased limits.
Map jam #1 - a community project at Func_Msgboard. The pack features 12 Honey-themed maps of varying sizes. It comes with a couple of modified models. The map sources are included.
notes: Some of the maps require an engine port with increased limits.

description: Small temple map using Kaahoo textures. A touched-up and expanded version of sock's entry from SM175.

Medium-sized vertical runic metal structures floating in the clouds, featuring base enemy and an integrated skill selection area, plus custom skybox as well as a few new sounds. The map source is included in the PAK.
notes: This map requires Quoth and an engine port with increased limits (as well as support for the -quoth command-line switch).

description: Large medieval city at nighttime with a strong focus on exploration and route choices. It comes with custom medieval-style items. The map source is included in the PAK.
notes: This map requires an engine port with increased limits.

description: Medium-sized medieval towers in a mine canyon with many secret areas that allow for somewhat nonlinear gameplay, a built-in skill selection area, and custom medieval-themed items. The map source is included in the pak.
notes: This map requires an engine port with increased limits.

description: Large brick-style dungeon with wind tunnels. It has a built-in skill selection area and comes with custom medieval items. The map source is included in the PAK.
notes: This map requires an engine port with increased limits.

description: Medium-sized metal dungeon in E3M6 mashup style with a built-in skill selection room. It also features custom item boxes. The map source is included.
notes: This is an optimized, stand-alone version of the level which stays within the vanilla Quake limits and does not require any special engine port. It does not include the custom item boxes from the previous version.

description: Medium-sized metal dungeon in E3M6 mashup style with a built-in skill selection room. It also features custom item boxes. The map source is included in the PAK.
notes: This map requires an engine port with increased limits. A standalone version optimized for vanilla Quake compatibility is available here.

description: Demo version of an atmospheric singleplayer campaign with three small medieval levels (two of which are remakes of the orignal E1M1 and E1M2). It features both normal gameplay and a new, very unique stealth mode. The enemy AI has been vastly improved, and there are countless visual overhauls and miscellaneous additions.
notes: This is version 1.1 which has several improvements and additions; version 1.0 can be found here.
